profile.headline: Problem Solver Extrodinaire
profile.summary:
IT Professional with a love of learning new things and tackling new challenges.

I started my IT career early in life by taking advantage of the course offerings my highschool had as well as investing the time into some independent studies to get my A+. I then later secured a job as an assistant in IT which later became a full-time position over the summer.

All of my job progression has been a product of my drive to always take on new opportunities, learn new things, and strengthen my know IT knowledge.

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
I started learning Website development back in 2017 and decided to use my skills as a way to make some side income while helping out a handful of small local businesses along the way. 

Learn more about my web work here: https://afrowebdev.com/

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description: I currently serve as one of the administrators over our network management applications and am responsible for keeping the workstations and servers of our clients in compliance as well as ensuring the integrity of backups, keeping devices up to date, and making sure that assets are properly tracked.

positions.title: Application Support Specialist
positions.description: Was one of 2 technicians who support Personify (an ERP software targeted at associations) and aided in Technical training as well as created and modified over 100 Knowledgebase documents and articles.

positions.title: IT Helpdesk Analyst
positions.description: Provide front line helpdesk support for the Department of medicine at Washington University and BJC Healthcare in St. Louis. I supported some of our custom apps as well as windows and mac workstations remotely.

positions.title: IT Helpdesk Analyst
positions.description: At True I served as an IT Helpdesk Team lead and helped support a series of custom apps, windows workstations, mac workstations, mobile devices, conference room equipment, factory controller machines, and various other forms of technology that True uses for day to day business.

positions.title: IT Web Support Technician
positions.description: Provided in-person and phone support for Missouri S&T's website management software, Terminal 4. Also conducted 1 on 1 and group training sessions on how to use the software/client. I also had the opportunity to train several new employees

positions.title: IT Walk-in Center Help Desk Technician
